purpose: Canonical shared Supabase migrations, configuration, generated types, and type-only consumer contract.
rules: Commit each ordered migration and regenerated src/database.generated.ts together. Consumers pin the contract.
Preserve the populated shared database. Never bypass reset-disposable-local.mjs guards; fresh-chain proofs require a separate explicitly disposable project.
Cloud type regeneration requires an explicit project identity. Deployment claims require current evidence, not historical documentation.
Shared Supabase migrations and generated database types are owned by ai-engineer-db-contract; consume its pinned contract. Do not create another migration/type authority.

Search explicit source paths first. Do not recursively enumerate artifacts, outputs, runs, receipts, caches, dependencies, or private notes. Read an individual artifact only when the task calls for it.
workspace/ is generated by npm run workspace:build; edit workspace-enrichment/ or the generator, never the tree; CI fails on drift (workspace:check) or non-reproducible pages (workspace:validate).
